newsitem.title: USA: Boomtown holders OK Hollywood deal.
newsitem.headline: Boomtown holders OK Hollywood deal.

text.p: Boomtown Inc said shareholders on Wednesday approved an April 23 merger agreement with Hollywood Park.
Completion of the merger is still subject to obtaining necessary gaming approvals. Boomtown plans to solicit consent of holders of Boomtown's First Mortgage Notes, it said.
If the merger is completed, each outstanding share of Boomtown common stock will be converted to the right to receive 0.625 of a share of Hollywood Park Common Stock.
Boomtown shareholders will no longer hold any interest in Boomtown other than through their interests and shares of Hollywood Park common stock.
The merger is expected to be completed during the first calendar quarter of 1997.
